留空 = 使用自动文案(随计费配置自动更新);填写 = 手动覆盖: Leave blank to use the auto copy (updates with billing config); fill in to override manually
去模型管理页定价: Go to model management to price this model
模型 {{name}} 不在当前列表页,请搜索后打开: Model {{name}} is not on the current list page, please search or turn pages to open it
素材价按类型独立配置,留空该类型不计费。: Material prices are configured per type. Leave a type blank to skip billing it.
JSON map of model → material price list. Each entry has material_type (image/video/audio), price_per_unit (images) or price_per_second (video/audio) and optional default_seconds. Configured models bill uploaded materials additively on top of generation cost.
Estimated seconds billed when a video ma: Estimated seconds billed when a video material has no explicit or measurable duration. Per-model default_seconds overrides this.
Estimated seconds billed when an audio m: Estimated seconds billed when an audio material has no explicit or measurable duration. Per-model default_seconds overrides this.
秒价为 0 或留空时，该分组不启用按秒计费。: A second price of 0 or blank disables per-second billing for the group.
价格填 0 表示该类型显式免费，条目保留。: A price of 0 marks the type as explicitly free (the entry is kept).
没有待上线的目录条目: No draft catalog entries to launch
该模型未定价,确认强制开闸?: This model is unpriced. Force launch?
「{{name}}」尚无定价配置。强制开闸后它将按兜底倍率(默认 37.5)计费: "{{name}}" has no pricing configured. After a force launch it will be billed at the fallback ratio (37.5 by default), which may not match its actual cost. Price it in model management first if possible.
以下模型未定价,确认强制开闸?: These models are unpriced. Force launch?
强制开闸后未定价模型将按兜底倍率(默认 37.5)计费。: Unpriced models will be billed at the fallback ratio (37.5 by default) after a force launch.
从指定渠道拉取上游定价并覆盖本地已上线模型的定价配置;分组独立价与目录手填定价不: Fetch upstream pricing from the selected channel and overwrite the pricing of live local models. Group-specific prices and catalog manual pricing are not touched.
一行一个模型名,留空表示同步全部已配置模型: One model name per line. Leave empty to sync all configured models.
上游没有返回可同步的模型条目: The upstream returned no syncable model entries
